text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...My legs are shaking.
I keep seeing flashes of when I lost before...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Even though I poured everything into training...
I still can't shake this anxiety...
choice_data_list: But it's also true that you pushed through that tough training!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I've worked so hard up to this day because I want to win...
――I'll give it everything I have right now...!
